features.feature: The transcript shows turns in time order: one speaker's lines joined while < 8 s apart and ≤ 60 s long, each with its time, speaker (Me / Remote / Speaker N / a name) and language chip
Find in transcript highlights every turn that contains the words
Each detected remote speaker has a colour of its own; `echoctl speakers <call> N=Name` names them in the transcript (no window control)
With no transcript the tab says "Listening…" (recording), "Transcribing on this computer…" or "No transcript for this call."
Selecting words and Comment, or right-clicking a turn or a minutes line → Add note, adds a note at that moment with the words quoted
A call made from a Teams transcript shows its turns with names from the transcript and "Me" as About me's name
